interpretations: Section 7 item 3 (per size) is run with eligibility determined at that size (the 336-only and 448-only analyses each apply the Section 2 eligibility rule), as implemented in nn/analyze_nn.py before the results were seen. The alternative reading (size-averaged eligibility set, n = 13) is given under per_size_alternative_reading for transparency; neither is decision-bearing.
Section 7 item 6 is reported as S20 = 1 - U(20) point values (the rho with U(20) itself has the opposite sign); summary.json labels it all18_point_U20.
Section 3 'nulls in the bracket' = the corner, ink and edge nulls at sigma 8, 16 and 25 px; U(20), A(20) and slope comparisons use the corner nulls only, as the rule states.
Section 7 item 8: summary.json lacked the Spearman rho for the training-objective family; it is computed here (secondary.competing.rho_objective_family).

primary.wording: The layer sweep neither supports nor rules out the receptive-field account (rho = -0.37, 95% CI [-0.62, -0.14], p = .218; pooled within-network rho = -0.27; adjusted R2 for receptive field 0.18 and for network identity -0.10).

inverted_u.wording: no evidence for a peak at an intermediate receptive field
